jobs.notes: Applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027 and offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027; 'closes' is null because the Law Society publishes two alternative closing dates (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027, 11:59pm) and each participating employer picks one, so no single close date can be stated — eligibility is generally penultimate (some firms final) year students.

jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales
jobs.notes: Applications open 9:00am AEST Mon 22 February 2027 and close 11:59pm AEST Sun 4 April 2027, with interviews commencing Tue 27 April 2027; for final-year students applying to participating firms and organisations.

The firm's own early careers page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, but no exact 2027 open/close dates are published yet, so both are null; the firm recruits to each state scheme's timetable.

Firm's own careers page confirms applications open 9:00am Wed 9 June 2027 and close 11:59pm Sun 11 July 2027, with offers made 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027 and accepted/declined by 1:00pm Thu 9 September 2027; open to penultimate-year students.
